title: Dynamic Voiceprint and Emotional Expression: Google DeepMind Launches Lyria 3.5 Music Generation Model

content_html:
Recently, the official team of Google DeepMind launched the next-generation music generation model Lyria3.5 on the Google Flow Music platform. This upgrade brings comprehensive technological innovations, achieving significant breakthroughs in musicality, lyric quality, vocal expressiveness, and creative control, marking that AI music creation is rapidly moving towards professional application scenarios.

In terms of core audio quality and structural design, Lyria3.5 demonstrates stronger expressive power. The new model can create more rich and complex melodic textures, resulting in a more natural and realistic listening experience. At the same time, its lyric generation module has enhanced semantic understanding and structural awareness of prompts, not only improving the quality of lyrics but also better aligning with the overall musical style.

Additionally, the vocal quality and creative control have seen significant progress. The new version produces vocals with emotional intensity and clear pronunciation, greatly enhancing the appeal of the final product. In terms of user experience, creators can now more conveniently adjust and control the rhythm and duration of the output content, thus achieving a more efficient and user-friendly personalized music creation process.

content_html_zh:
近日，Google DeepMind 官方团队在 Google Flow Music 平台上推出了下一代音乐生成模型 Lyria3.5。 此次升级带来全面的技术创新，在音乐性、歌词品质、声音表现力、创作控制等方面实现重大突破，标志着AI音乐创作正在快速走向专业应用场景。

在核心音质和结构设计上，Lyria3.5展现出了更强的表现力。 新模型可以创建更丰富、更复杂的旋律纹理，从而带来更自然、更真实的聆听体验。 同时，其歌词生成模块增强了提示的语义理解和结构意识，不仅提高了歌词质量，也更好地契合整体音乐风格。

此外，声音质量和创意控制也取得了显着进步。 新版本的人声情感强烈、发音清晰，大大增强了最终产品的吸引力。 在用户体验方面，创作者现在可以更方便地调整和控制输出内容的节奏和时长，从而实现更高效、人性化的个性化音乐创作过程。
